SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE (d.A12 > 6.0 OR d.A13 > 6.0)
  AND d.A10 > 65
  AND ((d.economic_resilience * 2 + d.financial_health_score * 3 + d.development_index) / 6) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.LDH > 500
  AND p.Date3 BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT s.School, s.Phone, sa.AvgScrRead, s.OpenDate, s.StatusType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 1
  AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2004-12-31'
  AND sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE favorite_language = 'E'
  AND Location LIKE '%Los Angeles%'
  AND Age IS NOT NULL
  AND Age < 28;

SELECT d.surname AS last_name, d.wikiUrl AS main_page
FROM drivers d
WHERE d.driverId IN (
  SELECT r.driverId FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE ra.year = 2016 AND r.points >= 25
)
AND (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ra2.year) FROM results r2
  JOIN races ra2 ON ra2.raceId = r2.raceId
  WHERE r2.driverId = d.driverId
) >= 5
ORDER BY d.surname ASC;

WITH career AS (
  SELECT r.driverId, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.year) AS seasons
  FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.driverId
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.surname AS last_name, d.wikiUrl AS main_page
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN career c ON c.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2016 AND r.points > 30 AND c.seasons >= 5
ORDER BY d.surname ASC;

  FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
  WHERE ra.year = 2016 AND r.points > 30
),
career AS (
  SELECT r.driverId, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.year) AS seasons_thru_2016
